title: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
description: Completed the Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) course from DeepLearning.AI, gaining hands-on skills in building systems that combine LLMs with external knowledge sources for accurate, context-aware responses. Covered document chunking, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and retrieval pipelines, along with techniques to reduce hallucinations and improve factual grounding — enabling me to design and optimize production-ready, knowledge-grounded AI applications.
short_description: Certified in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) by DeepLearning.AI, covering embeddings, vector search, and retrieval pipelines to build accurate, knowledge-grounded LLM applications — a key step toward becoming an AI/LLM engineer.

short_description: Completed Calculus for Machine Learning and Data Science by DeepLearning.AI on Coursera — covering derivatives, gradients, and optimization techniques essential for understanding and building machine learning algorithms.

short_description: Completed Linear Algebra for Machine Learning and Data Science by DeepLearning.AI on Coursera — covering vectors, matrices, eigenvalues, and their applications in machine learning algorithms and data transformations.
